summary: Read all 179 Chinese units of the office-history chapter and reviewed all 21 temporal or active-hint records and all five person summaries. The source explicitly attributes office changes to named emperors or reign contexts, but it does not date those discrete acts across every year of a full reign. The current full-reign intervals and derived active-date hints therefore require a narrow chronology repair; no source, person, mention, or translation content is changed by this initial audit.
